response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure work, and his TypeScript/React/Node skill set technically covers the job's core requirements. However, the role is explicitly junior/mid-level and entry-level in scope, and his seniority, breadth, and current Staff-level title represent a significant overqualification mismatch that raises concerns about compensation fit, role satisfaction, and retention.
strengths: Deep, broad full-stack experience including TypeScript, Node.js, React/Ember, and REST APIs
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) aligning with 'clean software architecture' interest
Based in Berlin, satisfying the on-site presence requirement
concerns: Significant seniority mismatch — Staff/Senior engineer applying to an entry-level position
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience mentioned (MongoDB/MySQL/SQL and Ember.js instead)
Likely salary expectations and career growth needs exceed what a junior role offers, risking early attrition
